name: ACP Claude Code Runtime
description: ACP runtime backend that uses the Claude Code CLI (claude) for agent sessions with streaming JSON I/O.

mcpConfig.description: Path to MCP config JSON file to inject into Claude Code sessions

command.label: Claude Code Command
command.help: Path or command name for the Claude Code CLI binary (default: 'claude').

model.label: Default Model
model.help: Model to use for Claude Code sessions (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-6).

permissionMode.label: Permission Mode
permissionMode.help: Claude Code permission mode for tool execution: default, plan, auto, approved, or bypass.

defaultCwd.label: Default Working Directory
defaultCwd.help: Default working directory for Claude Code sessions when not set per session.

maxTurns.label: Max Agentic Turns
maxTurns.help: Maximum number of agentic turns per non-interactive invocation.

maxBudgetUsd.label: Max Budget (USD)
maxBudgetUsd.help: Maximum dollar spend per session invocation.

systemPrompt.label: System Prompt Override
systemPrompt.help: Replace the default Claude Code system prompt.

appendSystemPrompt.label: Append System Prompt
appendSystemPrompt.help: Append additional instructions to the default system prompt.

allowedTools.label: Allowed Tools
allowedTools.help: Restrict Claude Code to these tools only (e.g. ["Bash", "Read", "Edit"]).

disallowedTools.label: Disallowed Tools
disallowedTools.help: Block specific tools from Claude Code sessions.

mcpConfig.label: MCP Config Path
mcpConfig.help: Path to a JSON file defining MCP servers to inject into Claude Code sessions.
